scope: E2 is an explicitly multi-invocation stage (D-15). These three configs differ from the source config in exactly paths.output_dir and two internals keys. Timing and memory are two DISTINCT runs because internals.benchmark_memory costs 2.7-5.5% wall clock, so one run cannot honestly produce both numbers; and internals.log_all_observation_depths (an ~11 MB per-stage sidecar on the 13-camera rig) rides the classification run ONLY, never the timing run (D-16). Each variant writes its own output_dir so every artifact is attributable to its invocation.

variants.name: classification
variants.purpose: Production / classification run. Carries Phase 25's per-observation h_q sidecar (D-16); carries NO memory instrumentation, because peak-RSS sampling perturbs the wall clock this run's artifacts are read alongside.

variants.name: timing
variants.purpose: Timing run. Carries NEITHER perturbing internals key: benchmark_memory costs 2.7-5.5% wall clock (D-15) and log_all_observation_depths writes an ~11 MB per-stage sidecar on the 13-camera rig (D-16). A flag that perturbs the quantity being measured cannot ride along with it.

variants.name: memory
variants.purpose: Memory run. Carries benchmark_memory only. This is a SEPARATE invocation from the timing run, inherited and non-negotiable (D-15): one run cannot honestly produce both numbers.
